resources.string: Independent app. Not endorsed by USGS. Data from official agencies.
Welcome to the Kilauea Alerts App,\n\nMahalo nui loa for using Kīlauea Alerts. Your feedback helps us keep improving something genuinely useful for Hawaiʻi Island.
Use the tabs along the bottom for the main pages. The Menu tab groups everything by category: official alerts, island conditions, live feeds, account tools, photos, and support.

Kīlauea volcano push alerts are included for everyone. Signing in is optional. Some features require additional resources, including broader alert categories, every Big Island weather location, and the full dashboard.
Explore safely, stay informed, and tell us what would help you most. We appreciate you.
